campaigns.core_idea: Package FirePit's group-sharing platters explicitly as match-night food, with a same-day ordering window -- close to a direct fit rather than a stretch, since BBQ platters are already built for group sharing.
campaigns.target_audience_angle: Groups of 4-6 hosting or attending PSL watch parties who default to ordering grilled food for exactly this kind of social, hands-on eating.

execution_directions.direction: A scaled-up family platter sized and priced for match-night groups, with a hard same-day cutoff time for ordering.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Removes decision friction for a customer who already knows they want grilled food for the match -- just makes FirePit the obvious specific choice.

execution_directions.direction: WhatsApp broadcast to past customers on match days.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Reaches an existing warm audience directly with a clear ordering deadline, rather than relying on same-day organic reach.

campaigns.core_idea: A fixed-price daily iftar combo that removes decision-making entirely for a customer ordering food every evening for a month -- a direct, high-volume fit for the highest-frequency group dining occasion of the year.
campaigns.target_audience_angle: Families ordering iftar delivery throughout Ramadan who want reliability and simplicity, not another menu to think through daily.

execution_directions.direction: Same combo every day (platter + naan + a cooling drink) for consistency and faster prep, with a reserved daily delivery slot.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Predictable production and predictable delivery both matter more than menu variety for a daily-use product during Ramadan.

execution_directions.direction: A practical, reliability-focused Facebook post aimed at parents/household organizers rather than a hype-driven one.
execution_directions.why_it_works: This audience is optimizing for one less decision, not novelty -- the message should match that.

campaigns.core_idea: A stretch, but a fun one -- a seekh kebab patty smashed and seared burger-style, riding the sustained smash-burger content format while staying true to FirePit's charcoal-grilling identity.
campaigns.target_audience_angle: Younger customers who follow food trend content on TikTok -- a one-time trial purchase, not a core menu bet.

execution_directions.direction: Limited-time-only menu item, promoted specifically as a trend tie-in rather than a permanent addition.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Keeps the risk small if it doesn't land, while still being a genuine product (not just a marketing gimmick) if it does.

execution_directions.direction: A close-up sizzle/sear TikTok in the classic smash-burger content format.
execution_directions.why_it_works: The format itself is inherently video-friendly and already has a proven audience appetite -- FirePit just needs to show up in it authentically.
